lines.text: Many learners say: I will call to you later.
Better: I will call you later.
Call does not need to before a person.
Call! I will call you later.

data.wrong: I will call to you later.
data.why: Call does not need to before a person.

native.hook: 「電話するね」は call to you？
native.tip: 「あなたに電話する」は call you。人の前に to は不要です。
native.caption: “I will call to you later.”と言っていませんか？😅 「あなたに電話する」の「に」を to にしてしまいがちです。“I will call you later.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“call”。“I will call you later.” を声に出して言ってみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: Say call you, with no to.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I will call to you later.” 😅 Do not add to before the person. The natural way is “I will call you later.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
